package.author: Alain
package.description: Local LLM API proxy with automatic channel failover.

en-US.author: Alain
en-US.description: Local LLM API proxy with automatic channel failover.
en-US.longDescription: OSW (One Switch) runs a proxy on your machine. Register every channel you have - different providers, accounts, and models - order them the way they should be tried, and point every AI client at a single local address. OSW identifies the protocol, picks a channel, moves on when one fails, and records exactly what happened. Your client only ever sees the attempt that succeeded.
en-US.name: OSW
en-US.releaseNotes:
New
- console: sign the request report with OSW and its homepage
- console: add copy-request and error-report actions to the contents sheet
Fixed
- app: start Electron only after the first build of every watcher finishes
- console: speak only for the upstream attempt in the contents sheet
- release: publish the CLI to npm inside release.yml
Changed
- request-logs: collapse the live-row rule to two cases
- unify the workspace scope and trim the dev/build scripts
- console: regroup the settings page around what each section answers
- console: rename the error report to a request report
- console: rebuild the contents-sheet footer buttons on the design-system button group
- console: pin the contents-sheet actions to a bottom footer and drop local ids from the facts

zh-CN.description: 把你手上所有的大模型渠道，合成一个本地地址。当前渠道挂了，自动换下一个。
zh-CN.longDescription: OSW 在本机跑一个代理服务。你把能用的渠道都配进来（不同供应商、不同账号、不同模型），排好优先级，然后让所有 AI 客户端统一指向一个本地地址。剩下的事它自己做：识别协议、按顺序挑渠道、把请求送出去、失败就换下一个，并把真实发生的一切记录清楚。于是客户端只会看到成功的那一次。
